source_name: SEC EDGAR (Electronic Data Gathering, Analysis, and Retrieval)
data_freshness: near real-time (submissions <1s; XBRL <1 min); company_tickers.json refreshed regularly

fields.meaning: SEC Central Index Key — the unique federal identifier for an SEC-registered filer (public company or fund). Stored as an integer in this file; must be zero-padded to 10 digits for data.sec.gov API calls (e.g. CIK0001045810).
fields.limitations: Identifies SEC filers only; not all companies have a CIK. Integer form loses leading zeros — pad to 10 digits before API joins.
fields.analysis_notes: Use as the federal primary key for public companies. Zero-pad to 10 digits for the canonical company_id.

fields.meaning: Primary stock-exchange ticker symbol associated with the filer.
fields.limitations: company_tickers.json lists one primary ticker; companies with multiple share classes have separate entries in company_tickers_exchange.json. Only filers with a public ticker appear here (~10,405), excluding many non-trading SEC filers.
fields.analysis_notes: Useful secondary join/display key. Not unique across share classes.

fields.meaning: Company / filer name as registered with the SEC.
fields.limitations: Casing is inconsistent (some all-caps, some mixed). Reflects the SEC filer name, which may differ from the state-registered legal name. No former-name history in this file.
fields.analysis_notes: Use as display name for public companies; richer/canonical name and former names available via the submissions API.

fields.source_field: addresses / sic / sicDescription / formerNames / fiscalYearEnd / stateOfIncorporation
fields.meaning: The data.sec.gov submissions endpoint (https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK##########.json) returns a richer company profile: business and mailing addresses, SIC industry code + description, state of incorporation, fiscal year end, former names with date ranges, EIN, phone, and full filing history.
fields.limitations: Documented from SEC API reference, NOT downloaded in this investigation. Field names/shapes are from public SEC documentation and not verified against a stored sample here. Requires a descriptive User-Agent header with contact email or returns HTTP 403; 10 req/s/IP limit.
fields.analysis_notes: Planning-only. To enrich a public company with address, industry (SIC), incorporation state, EIN, and former names, fetch the per-CIK submissions JSON. Treat field presence as documented-but-unverified until a sample is captured.

fields.meaning: The XBRL company-facts endpoint exposes structured financial statement values (revenue, assets, net income, etc.) reported in filings, keyed by US-GAAP/DEI taxonomy concept with per-period values and units.
fields.limitations: Documented from SEC API reference, not downloaded. Only available for filers that submit XBRL financials. Large per-company payloads — fetch on demand, not in bulk for every company.
fields.analysis_notes: Planning-only source of audited financials for public companies. Map selected concepts (Revenues, Assets, NetIncomeLoss) into the financial section when needed.
